summary: Two blocking spec-review findings require small spec repairs: define the bare built-in provider-family default selection rule and remove the conflicting dry-run diagnostic wording.

items.title: Provider-family default behavior is underspecified against ProviderRegistry
items.rationale: The spec must state a deterministic selection rule for agent.default: "codex" because Issue #378's observed config depends on that bare built-in provider-family value resolving.
items.evidence: spec.json R3 and AC1 currently say provider-family keys resolve when ProviderRegistry can resolve that family, but spec-review verified ProviderRegistry.resolveProfile("codex") currently returns null for built-in Codex profiles.

items.title: Dry-run diagnostic requirement conflicts with current Agent.call behavior
items.rationale: The spec should preserve the current _dryRun short-circuit contract and test diagnostics through unresolved Agent.call without _dryRun or direct resolution seams.
items.evidence: spec.json scope mentions Agent.call dry-run failure diagnostic coverage, while src/lib/agent.js returns immediately when opts._dryRun is true before Agent.resolve runs.
